title: Automate evidence collection and attestation for tenant isolation on Dedicated clusters
creator: Marcus Liu
description: Goal: implement an automated evidence and reporting pipeline that generates tenant-level attestations proving data residency controls and logical isolation for Dedicated capacity customers. This ticket covers collection, tamper-evident storage, periodic attestations generation (PDF + machine-readable JSON), and an API/console endpoint for customers and auditors to fetch historical evidence. Scope excludes on-prem packaging work (handled in a separate Private deployment ticket).
acceptance_criteria: Automated collector runs on Dedicated control plane and worker nodes, producing event bundles for tenant creation, network policy changes, storage location pins, and VM/GPU assignments
Evidence bundles are timestamped, signed by the platform signing key, and stored in immutable object storage with lifecycle controls
Attestation generator produces a human-readable PDF and a signed JSON statement containing residency assertions for the requested time window
Console and API endpoints return attestations for a tenant_id with RBAC checks; successful retrieval logs an audit event
End-to-end tests cover: collector -> S3 store -> attestation generation -> fetch API; performance impact on latency < 2% for normal request paths
Security review completed and threat-model notes addressed (key rotation, signer KMS policy)
Operational runbook created for manual re-generation of attestations and incident handling

decisions: Use signed JSON + PDF attestation pair for both machine and human consumption
Store evidence bundles in a write-once S3 bucket with object lock enabled; metadata indexed in Postgres for fast lookup
Collectors run as a DaemonSet on Dedicated worker nodes and as control-plane hooks for tenant lifecycle events
Attestation signing performed by a service account whose private signing key is stored in KMS/HSM; rotation documented
Expose attestation retrieval via /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/attestations and enable SSO-protected console view
tradeoffs_and_risks: Comprehensive evidence increases storage and CPU costs; mitigation: bundle pruning, incremental diffs, retention policy per-customer
Agent collectors add surface area on Dedicated nodes; mitigation: minimal privileges, read-only operations, mandatory code review and e2e tests
Attestation generation delays for long time-windows; mitigation: streaming generation and precompute for monthly snapshots
Legal wording is final at time of sign-off; future regulator requests may require additional fields
implementation_notes: Phase 1 (MVP): collector binary + control-plane hooks, S3 write-once storage, attestation generator service, fetch API, console link
Phase 2: retention-per-tenant UI in Console, scheduled monthly attestations, audit-log export for SOC2 artifacts
Metrics to track: number of attestations generated, avg generation time, storage used per tenant, failed signer attempts
Local dev script: ./dev/tools/generate_attestation.sh --tenant <id> which replays sample bundles and writes to local-minio for debugging
rollout_plan: Week 1: Deploy collectors and store to staging; run end-to-end flow against synthetic tenants
Week 2: Canary deployment to 3 pilot Dedicated tenants (volunteer customers) with opt-in flag; collect feedback
Week 3: Ramp to 25% of Dedicated clusters; monitor metrics and error rates; freeze schema changes
Week 4: Global rollout and announce via customer success; publish runbook and attestation FAQ
qa_and_testing: Unit tests for collector bundle formats (schema validation)
Integration tests verifying signature verification end-to-end
Chaos test: simulate node clock skew and network partition during evidence writing
Pen test: validate collectors cannot exfiltrate tenant secrets beyond the bundle
